Renewal reminders 7/3/1 days before billing, plus one-click cancel links straight to each service. $2.99/mo or $30/yr — a quarter of Rocket Money's price, no bill-negotiation upsell, no app to install. Just a fast web app at streamhopper.co.

records.name: Carbon Voice
records.tagline: Record your voice. Share a link. Skip the meeting.
records.description: The fastest way to record a voice message and get a shareable link (transcript included). Send it anywhere you'd send a meeting invite. Recipients can read or listen and reply to start an async voice conversation. Reduces meeting time by up to 60%!

records.name: VidShift
records.tagline: Free video and audio tools that run in your browser
records.description: VidShift is a free video and audio toolkit that runs 100% in your browser. Convert, compress, trim, mute, rotate, change speed, extract audio or frames, and create GIFs. No uploads, no sign-up, no watermarks, no ads. Your files never leave your device. Supports MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV, MP3, FLAC and 12+ formats. Built with WebAssembly for native-speed processing.

records.name: Flowna
records.tagline: Turn irregular income into a calm daily spending number
records.description: Flowna turns unpredictable income into one calm number you can spend today without breaking your week. Log by voice, photo, SMS, or tap. Built for hustlers in Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana & South Africa.

records.name: TDo
records.tagline: Your AI team that executes — not just assists
records.description: TDo gives you a team of 35 specialized AI agents organized into 7 functional teams. Assign a goal. Your AI team orchestrates the work, executes in parallel, and delivers results. Built for founders who want to move faster without hiring.

records.name: Tones
records.tagline: tap. talk. send. set the tone.
records.description: Tones is the calmest way to talk to the people you love. Open a chat → unheard voice notes play automatically. Tap once to record, tap again to send. That’s the whole app. No feeds. No likes. No read receipts. No public profiles. No algorithm deciding what you hear. Just voice — the part of conversation that text strips out: laughter, sarcasm, “I miss you.” Built solo. Free. iOS.

records.name: Teckinfo Solutions -
records.tagline: Click to call dialer
records.description: ID cloud Click to call software enables seamless, real-time communication between businesses and customers with just a single click. By integrating click-to-call API buttons into CRM systems, lead management tools, mobile apps, and third-party platforms, businesses can instantly connect agents with prospects, eliminating manual dialing and reducing wait times. Organizations have the flexibility to choose the type of deployment best suited for them i.e. Cloud, Hybrid or On Premises.

records.name: Globe
records.tagline: Learn world geography one swipe at a time
records.description: Globe turns geography into a daily habit, one swipe at a time. Open the app, swipe through full-screen fact cards, and learn something new about countries, capitals, flags, food, history, and more. Personalized to your interests and expertise level. Tracks what you've seen so you never get the same fact twice. Fully offline, no account or internet needed. Think Duolingo for geography, but lighter and faster. Free to download, premium for personalized access.

records.name: A Better Gift
records.tagline: Personal fundraising, just for friends and family
records.description: GoFundMe was built for strangers on the internet. A Better Gift is built for the people who already love you. Create a request for medical bills, car repairs, home expenses, or anything else life throws at you. Share privately with friends and family. Receive funds directly to your bank account. A simpler, more personal way to ask for help — and an easier way to give it.

records.name: Best Influencer Marketing Services
records.tagline: influencer marketing services in india
records.description: Talentrack is India's leading influencer marketplace offering effective influencer marketing services to find influencers, run campaigns, and boost engagement.

records.name: Cloud Upload
records.tagline: Free 20-min AWS security audit. $499 deep version
records.description: Run a free automated AWS security audit on your own account in 20 minutes with a read-only CloudFormation role, no credentials shared. Account-level severity by category, top 3 priorities. $499 unlocks all 40+ findings, CIS v1.5 mapping, and per-finding remediation CLI.

records.name: cosskill
records.tagline: Practice difficult conversations with AI personas.
records.description: cosskill lets you practice difficult real-world conversations with AI personas that simulate distinct communication styles. Rehearse breakups, salary negotiations, workplace conflicts, and tough decisions. Start instantly — free, no signup, no filters. 6 curated method personas with structured frameworks.

records.name: EconomyBot — Discord Economy Bot
records.tagline: A Discord economy bot no paywalls, no premium tiers
records.description: Most economy bots lock their best features behind a paywall. EconomyBot doesn't. Custom currency, casino games (Blackjack, Roulette, Slots, Coinflip), daily rewards with streaks, achievements, a role shop and a full web dashboard all completely free. Every setting is configurable per server. No commands needed to set things up, just use the dashboard.

records.name: Mercvox
records.tagline: AI receptionist for the trade businesses
records.description: Mercvox answers every call your trades business misses — 24/7. Our AI receptionist qualifies leads, books jobs, and syncs straight into Jobber. Purpose-built for plumbers, HVAC techs, and electricians losing thousands to voicemail. 7 days free.

records.name: Plume RSS Reader
records.tagline: Modern, lightweight Free RSS reader for Android
records.description: Plume is a modern, lightweight RSS reader built for focused reading. It features full offline support (including images), Text-to-Speech, and intuitive swipe gestures. Built with a "Privacy First" philosophy: Zero tracking, no ads, and no third-party analytics. Your data stays on your device and your RSS provider. Seamlessly integrates with Feedly and TheOldReader.`

records.name: Luli - Lucid Applikation
records.tagline: Lucid dreams, dreams, App, Awareness, software
records.description: I’ve been fascinated by dreams forever. We spend a third of our lives asleep, but most of it is just a blank space. I wanted to change that. LuLi is a passion project I built to make lucid dreaming accessible while protecting your privacy. Unlike other apps, your dream journal never leaves your device. It’s 100% local. Using smartwatch data, LuLi gently guides you into awareness during REM. Join the journey!

records.name: Docsmith — AI API Docs in 60 Seconds
records.tagline: OpenAPI spec → polished docs site in 60 seconds
records.description: Upload an OpenAPI spec (JSON/YAML, v2 or v3). 60 seconds later: a polished docs site — endpoint descriptions, parameter tables, curl examples, error codes. Exports to self-hosted HTML + Markdown. Free for 1 doc/month. $19 once for unlimited.

records.name: FreeViralKit
records.tagline: 10x your YouTube views with AI-generated titles & SEO
records.description: Free AI-powered YouTube SEO tool. Generate viral titles, optimized descriptions, trending hashtags, and SEO tags for your YouTube videos. Boost views, subscribers, and rankings instantly.

records.name: DasshAI
records.tagline: https://dassh.ai/
records.description: Dassh AI (dassh.ai) builds AI recruitment technology for India’s mid-market. Their AI recruiter, Stella, autonomously handles screening, voice interviews, scheduling, and shortlisting — replacing manual recruiter tasks end-to-end. Founded by IIT Bombay graduates, SINE-incubated, and backed by 30 years of recruitment expertise through the Harjai Group.
